stops.note: a heap of stones; the Cairngorm mountains take their name from An Càrn Gorm, 'the blue cairn'
used for prehistoric burial mounds like Orkney's chambered cairn of Maeshowe (c. 2800 BC); the Skye-bred Cairn terrier later played Toto in the 1939 film The Wizard of Oz

current_meaning: a mound of stones built as a memorial or landmark
